invite.title: Your project could be here
invite.text: Tell us what you need and we'll figure out how to build it.

steps.name: You message us
steps.text: On Telegram or WhatsApp. Tell us about your business and what you need. Voice messages are fine.

steps.name: We estimate
steps.text: We send what we'll build, how long it takes and what it costs. Work starts once you agree.

steps.name: We build
steps.text: You see the design and work-in-progress versions. Changes happen along the way, not at the end.

steps.name: We launch
steps.text: We test on phones and computers, publish on your domain and hand over all access.

items.q: How much does a website cost?
items.a: We price every project individually — it all depends on the scope. Describe the task and we'll send you an estimate before any work starts.
A landing page usually takes a couple of weeks. A site with a catalog or a bot takes longer. We give the exact timeline together with the price.

items.q: Can you redo my old website?
items.a: Yes. First we look at what already works and keep it. Then we change what gets in the way.

items.q: What do you need from me?
items.a: A few words about your business and a link to your site, if you have one. Logo, photos and copy if you have them. If not, we'll help you find them.
